english.title: Superintendent registrar solemnize a void marriage
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a superintendent registrar, knowingly and wilfully solemnized

(A)_[in your office the marriage]_
(B)_[the marriage, in pursuance of section 26(1)(bb) of the Marriage Act 1949,]_
(C)_[the marriage, in pursuance of section 26(1)(dd) of the Marriage Act 1949,]_
(D)_[the marriage, in pursuance of section 26B(6) of the Marriage Act 1949,]_

of **(..SPECIFY THE PARTIES TO THE MARRIAGE..) which was void by virtue of **(..SPECIFY PROVISION..) of Part III the Marriage Act 1949
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(3)(d) of the Marriage Act 1949.
